title: EvoBelief: Falsifiable World Models for Self-Improving LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.12789v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Self-evolving LLM agents typically improve how they act through accumulated experience, reflection, or skills. Yet even procedurally capable agents can fail when their beliefs about environment dynamics are incomplete, incorrect, or outdated. We study a complementary axis of self-evolution: evolving those beliefs during deployment. Such beliefs can support multiple tasks, but incorrect ones can also propagate across them. We introduce EvoBelief, a self-evolving world model that represents environment knowledge as falsifiable hypotheses. Unexpected outcomes and decision-relevant unknowns trigger hypothesis formation. Later observations and controlled experiments provide independent validation before a rule can guide predictions or plans within its supported scope. Counterexamples narrow or retire rules as the environment changes. The language model remains frozen, and each rule remains linked to its evidence and the decisions it changes.

translated_title: EvoBelief：面向自我改进大语言模型智能体的可证伪世界模型
translated_abstract: 自我演化的LLM智能体通常通过积累经验、反思或技能来改进其行动方式。然而，即使程序性能力很强的智能体，如果其对环境动态的信念不完整、错误或过时，也可能失败。我们研究自我演化的一个互补维度：在部署过程中演化这些信念。这类信念可以支持多个任务，但错误的信念也可能在任务之间传播。我们提出了EvoBelief，这是一种自我演化的世界模型，它将环境知识表示为可证伪的假设。意外结果和与决策相关的未知因素会触发假设的形成。后续的观察和受控实验会提供独立验证，之后规则才能在其支持范围内指导预测或规划。随着环境的变化，反例会缩小或淘汰规则。语言模型本身保持冻结，每条规则都与其证据以及它所改变的决策保持关联。
tldr: 提出EvoBelief，一种将环境知识表示为可证伪假设的自我演化世界模型，通过意外事件触发假设形成、独立验证后方可在支持范围内指导决策、并利用反例随环境变化修正或淘汰规则，使语言模型保持冻结的同时在部署中持续演化智能体的环境信念。
en_tdlr: EvoBelief introduces a self-evolving world model that represents environment knowledge as falsifiable hypotheses, enabling frozen LLM agents to continuously refine their beliefs during deployment through hypothesis formation, independent validation, and counterexample-driven rule revision.
